The Forty-Six Golden Tickets: a close reading

a sequence of 46 compact, numbered compositions written in emoji and logical notation, presented as the original source from which Lee Sharks translated The Secret Book of Walt: Hidden Teachings of Walt Whitman, Cowboy of Time.
Its most interesting formal decision is that it refuses to translate itself into ordinary explanatory prose.
Deposit #1693 therefore restores the original's textual representation to the archive, rather than claiming to have recovered the physical artifacts.
The work's fictional or literary frame looks forward to 2037, while its actual archival deposit occurs in 2026.
